description: Manage the ai.exchange and ai.provider_keys namespaces of OpenVibe.AI through openvibe-shared/config (D11): GET /internal/config lists the namespace summaries, GET /internal/config/:namespace returns one as common.config-namespace@1, POST applies common.config-change@1, and PUT /internal/config/:namespace/secrets/:key sets a secret with common.config-secret-put@1 (write-only; the answer is the marker) while DELETE removes it. Only Network's admin proxy, acting for the owner, holds this capability; it is never grantable to apps. Each request carries the owner as actor, and the service audits every write with that actor and key, never a secret value.
